package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_parses_config_or_feature_flags_inline: Handlers that read feature flags, tenant configuration, or rollout toggles directly instead of using injected policy/config abstractions.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func GetCheckoutOptionsHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	enableNewFlow, _ := strconv.ParseBool(os.Getenv("ENABLE_NEW_CHECKOUT"))
	maxItems, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("MAX_CHECKOUT_ITEMS"))
	tenantFeature := os.Getenv("TENANT_FEATURE_FLAG")

	if tenantFeature == "beta" || enableNewFlow {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
			"flow":        "new",
			"max_items":   maxItems,
			"tenant_mode": tenantFeature,
		})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
		"flow":      "legacy",
		"max_items": 10,
	})
}
